svg.title: Jovie mark construction
svg.text: Every letter in the word is cut from this ring.
0.45 of the outer width, kept from the original mark
horizontals read heavier, so they are drawn 3% thinner
a ball of ⌀ = ring thickness on the ring midline at 12
hairline 16 u, concentric with the seed
opens to 46 u in the text master (1 px at 16 px)
Drawn as font outlines, spaced by area, kerned by eye.
144 u = ring side ÷ 1.04. Rounds are drawn heavier to look equal.
hook is the O's bowl at 234 u radius, flush with the stem, cut flat at 9.
diagonals 134 u (0.93 of stem), flat foot 60 u so the join never clogs.
round dot ⌀ 144 u, top on the cap line plus overshoot.
top/bottom 0.83, bar 92 u (0.61): the strongest contrast, so the eye stays open.
each side = 54 u minus the white its own shape encloses (to 0.22 x-height deep).
Clear space is half the O on every side.
Below 24 px the text master opens the seam and loosens spacing. The 16, 24 and 32 px marks are pixel masters: every tangent edge sits on a whole pixel.
One ink per surface. The mark never takes an accent fill.
